purpose: Record the first fail-closed mismatch found while connecting the frozen independent semantic specification to the current implementation.

comparison_layers.independent_requirement: Actual knots in S3, framed knots, embedded dotted spanning disks, complete puncture data, closing-boundary certificate, and geometric boundary maps.
comparison_layers.implementation_supply: Serialized planar components/events plus category-neutral geometry certificates, but no constructor into the independently declared KnotInS3/EmbeddedDiskInS3 primitives.
comparison_layers.forbidden_shortcut: Do not interpret strings or component records as literal knots/disks merely to inhabit the independent structure.

comparison_layers.independent_requirement: KirbyH2 is ker(boundaryTwo from primal C2 to primal C1) modulo im(boundaryThree from primal closing C3 to primal C2).
comparison_layers.implementation_supply: The evaluator uses the handle complex of counts.turnedOver; its degree-three generators are primal dotted one-handles, not primal closing three-handles.
comparison_layers.missing_theorem: An explicit Poincare-duality comparison, natural under all eight moves, between the independent primal KirbyH2 and the implementation's dual handle-chain second homology.

not_claimed: The independent semantic specification and implementation are fully connected.
The two marking groups are definitionally equal.
Poincare duality alone fixes the intended character-exponent convention without an explicit comparison map.

legal_resolution_options.description: Keep the independent primal H2 semantics and refactor the evaluator to use the primal handle complex.
Change the frozen independent semantics to state the dual handle complex explicitly, then re-review and re-pin every affected semantic hash.
Keep both conventions and prove an explicit, move-natural Poincare-duality comparison; define exactly how alpha enters the dual evaluator through that comparison.
